name: [SKINS] SLEDGE
desc:
[ ❗ ] GAME IS IN TESTING. EXPECT BUGS, SERVER MIGRATIONS, AND BALANCE CHANGES

Can you survive Sledge?

SURVIVORS: Run, hide, and use barricades to slow Sledge down. Barricades cannot be broken while they are being placed, so time them carefully to buy yourself a few extra seconds.

SLEDGE: Hunt down every survivor before time runs out. Smash through soft walls to create shortcuts, cut survivors off, and find ways around barricades.

Unlock new abilities for both Sledge and Survivors, learn the maps, and use every advantage you can get!
